rows.name: VIX level and risk regime
rows.verdict: Exact-session direction and incremental value are unmeasured; conditional regime candidates only.

rows.name: VIX level and change at the cutoff
rows.verdict: Matched spot VIX duplicates F1; consolidate ownership and remove any independent duplicate vote.

rows.name: US 2Y yield, five-session change
rows.verdict: A plausible policy channel does not establish next-session direction; no fixed sign or weight survives.

rows.name: US minus Germany 2Y spread, five-session change
rows.verdict: Relative-policy mechanism survives; the exact-session predictive contribution has no measurement.

rows.name: US 10Y real yield, five-session change
rows.verdict: Real-rate mechanisms survive conditionally; exact-session direction is unmeasured.

rows.name: US front-end rate change
rows.verdict: Exact-session benefit of front-end innovations is unmeasured; DGS2 alone duplicates F2.

rows.name: US minus Germany front-end spread
rows.verdict: Relative policy is supported as a channel, not as an established London-session forecast.

rows.name: US real yield change
rows.verdict: Real-rate and maturity-shape hypotheses remain unvalidated for the exact target.

rows.name: Term premium and curve
rows.verdict: Neither slope nor estimated premium has accepted exact-session predictive evidence.

rows.name: Credit spread change
rows.verdict: The credit mechanism and evidence from other outcomes do not establish exact-session USD prediction.

rows.name: Broad dollar momentum
rows.verdict: Lagged broad-dollar information is a candidate; the exact-session DXY effect is unmeasured.

rows.name: Gold five-session change
rows.verdict: Conditional gold mechanisms survive, not an exact-session inverse-dollar forecast.

rows.name: Dollar smile
rows.verdict: A descriptive mechanism survives; no exact-session measured smile rule is established.

rows.name: Equity versus USD
rows.verdict: Equity/FX common-shock mechanisms survive; the next-session lead is unmeasured.

rows.name: Economic surprise / release surprise
rows.verdict: The stored signal cannot certify the highest-weight family; traceable innovations remain candidates.

rows.name: F8 Fed bias
rows.verdict: No exact-session role is established for a timeless bias string; dated text innovation is a separate candidate.

rows.name: Release surprise at first print
rows.verdict: A sound surprise definition survives, but the exact-session effect and the complete dataset are unmeasured.

rows.name: USD session momentum
rows.verdict: Other-window FX momentum does not establish one- or five-day DXY direction in this session.

rows.name: USD overnight range position
rows.verdict: The candidate state survives; treating a historical range as a hard future bound is rejected.

rows.name: USD session volatility regime
rows.verdict: Dispersion evidence is not evidence of superior no-call decisions for the exact session.

rows.name: Safe-haven demand
rows.verdict: Haven and funding mechanisms do not establish a universal or exact-session USD sign.

rows.name: Risk-on / risk-off cross-asset state
rows.verdict: The conditional state is a research candidate; exact-session directional value is unmeasured.

rows.name: Known releases between cutoff and endpoint
rows.verdict: Calendar context is valid if archived; direction, confidence and abstention effects are unmeasured.

rows.name: Days since and until high-impact events
rows.verdict: Distance is observable context if the schedule is archived, not an established direction or measured positioning.

rows.name: Data-quality gate for abstention
rows.verdict: Reject invalid indispensable inputs or use a prespecified fallback; integrity is required, predictive gain unmeasured.

signals.label: VIX level and risk regime
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen VIX regime vote: high and rising volatility votes -1 USD, low and falling +1

signals.label: VIX five-session change
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen VIX momentum vote: a rising five-session change votes -1 USD, a falling change +1

signals.label: Safe-haven demand
signals.vote_rule: RG-5: gold and JPY both weaken by more than 0.25% votes +1 USD, both strengthen -1, otherwise 0; CHF never votes alone
signals.source: Cached gold H1 and H.10 USD/JPY; CHF confirmation only

signals.label: Broad dollar momentum
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen broad-dollar vote: a five-session rise votes +1 USD, a fall -1
signals.source: FRED DTWEXBGS, a declared stand-in for ICE DXY

signals.label: USD session momentum
signals.vote_rule: the mean of the two mirror votes; the pair is one factor and votes once, not twice
signals.source: EUR/USD and USD/JPY cached H1 tape, declared proxies for the DXY path

signals.label: Overnight range position
signals.vote_rule: RG-3: range position at least 0.70 votes +1 USD, at most 0.30 -1, otherwise 0; a range below 10 pips is undefined

signals.label: Gold five-session change
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen gold vote: a five-session fall votes +1 USD, a rise -1
signals.source: Cached XAU/USD H1, labelled as the Coinbase quote

signals.label: Equity versus USD
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen equity vote: a five-session fall votes +1 USD, a rise -1
signals.source: Cached NAS100 H1, labelled where the rule names QQQ

signals.label: F8 Fed bias
signals.vote_rule: RG-2: a hawkish statement shift votes +1 USD, dovish -1, neutral 0; a statement released after the cutoff cannot vote that morning
